app.title: Microsoft's ONNX Runtime has disappeared from GitHub
app.description: ONNX Runtime is a cross-platform, high-performance scoring engine for Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) models. It provides a lightweight runtime that can be embedded in applications or deployed as a server for inference.
proposed_tests: Create a small ONNX model, load with onnxruntime and run inference
Measure inference latency and compare to baseline
